course_description: This course provides an overview of the Computing Industry and Computing profession, including Research and Applications in different fields; an Appreciation of Computing in different fields such as Biology, Sociology, Environment, and Gaming; an understanding of ACM requirements; an appreciation of the history of computing; and knowledge of the icy components of computer systems (organizations and architecture), Malware, Computer Security, Internet and Internet protocols, HTML4/5 and CSS.

course_learning_outcomes.text: Select the appropriate computer components to build, repair, or upgrade personal computers

topic_learning_outcomes.text: Explain how to keep personal computer components safe.
Explain the features and functions of computer components.

course_learning_outcomes.text: Study the fundamental ethical principles that form the basis for the ACM Code of Ethics and Professional Conduct.
Understand and apply the concepts involving framework for website development.
Utilize design standards in planning the layout, design, and development of a complete website.

topic_learning_outcomes.text: Understand the ACM Code of Ethics and Professional Conduct to guide the ethical conduct of all computing professionals.
Study the basic concepts of HTML.
Use HTML elements and attributes in designing Web pages.

Apply the various standards in the planning and design of websites using CSS. Collaboration, Skilled Communication, Knowledge Construction, Self-Regulation, Real-World Problem-Solving, Use of ICT (not part of the topic, but integrated into assessments)
